title: The Patrick Mahomes/Travis Kelce 1587 Prime restaurant draws a copyright lawsuit

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: The Patrick Mahomes/Travis Kelce 1587 Prime restaurant draws a copyright lawsuit
sources.description: The restaurant started by Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes and tight end Travis Kelce is getting some free publicity, via an apparent effort by a largely unknown sneaker company to generate some free publicity.
